parameters.content:
## Content Ingestion

POST /webhook/content-upload - the portal composer (POST /api/upload) files a media item into Drive and appends a Content Calendar row with all six platform status columns.

GET /webhook/content-list - the portal calendar (GET /api/posts) and pre-flight read the calendar.

Media is filed in the Chambers Vault root; point "Upload Media to Drive" at a dedicated folder if you keep one.

**Before publishing:** Google Drive + Google Sheets credentials, and the "VBL Portal Webhook Key" Header Auth credential on both webhooks.
